keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for 1815-1819, which Cliopatria lacks (its row starts in 1820): infobox 'Restored: 9 July 1815'; 'Frankfurt was returned to its pre-Napoleonic constitution via the Congress of Vienna of 1815' and became a sovereign city-state in the German Confederation. Same footprint as the corrected 1820 shape, drawn round Frankfurt and not on Cliopatria's misplaced cell. Cliopatria's cell is misplaced: shapes.csv gives it a bounding box of 8.2607-8.4306 E, 49.98-50.113 N and a centroid at 8.346 E, 50.046 N, on the lower Main towards Mainz-Kastel and Rüsselsheim, while Frankfurt am Main lies at 8.68 E, 50.11 N (gazetteer 8.675/50.10; the capital below 8.6821/50.1109), about 25 km east of the centroid and outside the box. Corrected to a radius of 8 km round Frankfurt (about 200 km2, the same order as the 178 km2 cell), the radius the ledger already uses.

Corrected to a radius of 8 km round Frankfurt (about 200 km2, the same order as the 178 km2 cell), the radius the ledger already uses. The page gives no total area ('The territory of the Free City included the actual city of Frankfurt as the city district, eight villages' and a forest district of 22,123 morgen, 4,480 hectares), so there is no infobox figure to compare; the City Forest alone is 'almost 40 square kilometers', consistent with a territory of this order. The area is plausible; the position is what is wrong.

ledger.note: 1815: Frankfurt is restored as a free city. Infobox 'Restored: 9 July 1815'; 'Frankfurt was returned to its pre-Napoleonic constitution via the Congress of Vienna of 1815' and 'became a sovereign city-state and a member of the German Confederation'. The page gives the year and the territory, not the previous holder's end date (Dalberg's Grand Duchy of Frankfurt is dated 1810-13).

ledger.note: 1866: Prussia occupies the Free City. 'On 16 July 1866 the undefended city was occupied by the Prussian Army under their General Eduard Vogel von Falckenstein.' The city stays a state, under occupation, until the annexation of 20 September.

notes:
Page budget 1 of 1-2 used (Free City of Frankfurt). Cliopatria's two shapes (1820-1864, 1865) are one H3 cell of about 178 km2 and the row stops a year before the annexation; two new keyframes (1815-1819 and 1866) complete the life.
COUNTERPARTS. grand-duchy-of-frankfurt (Dalberg's state, 1810-13; the Principality of Frankfurt before it) has no Cliopatria row and no dossier yet. kingdom-of-prussia exists but its Cliopatria row ends in 1863, so the annexation has no matching Prussian shape after 1863 (the 1866 gain should appear in the Prussia dossier even though the row is absent).
NOT RECORDED. The 1848-1849 National Assembly in the Paulskirche (18 May 1848) is not a territorial event. The page gives no total area and no 1816 constitution date ('The supplementing file to the Frankfurt Constitution of 1816').
